items.name: fused AdamW
items.what: FusedAdamW: the whole AdamW update batched through torch._foreach_* (p *= 1-lr*wd; m,v; sqrt/div/add; addcdiv) -> ~7 batched kernels instead of one Addcdiv + two scalar ops per parameter tensor
items.why_not_aclnn: torch_npu.npu_apply_adam_w tried first: 1.729 vs 0.622 ms eager for 24 tensors (2.7x slower) and disagreed with torch.optim.AdamW by 1.4e-04 per step at wd=0 (beta-power convention differs) -> unusable
items.note: only 21.3 ms in training although it removes ~585 Addcdiv kernels: each acts on a <=192x384 tensor, so they were numerous but never expensive

items.name: band_split normalize chain

measured_ceiling.ceiling_ms: ~6-8 (2.5 ms forward normalize chain + comparable backward)

items.blocker: the existing triton kernel (npu_kernels_bandunet.bandsplit_norm_scale, measured 1.43-1.51x) fuses normalize+scale+gamma, but each of the 62 bands then needs its own GEMM with a different n_feat (4..132); fusing that means a kernel family plus a real backward, for a ceiling under 1% of the step

items.name: SwiGLU / gating / residual
items.already_on: triton_blocks.fused_silu_mul is already the default in LocalBandBlock (_TRITON_SILU=1) with an autograd Function whose gradient truncation was fixed; _FAST_BLOCK folds the residual into the projection GEMM

measured_ceiling.note: block0 fwd+bwd = 234 kernels whose top entries are Cast/Transpose/Slice/Add, not Mul; the remaining Mul are attention scale, RMSNorm and MSC gates on 2-8 MB tensors -> the same ~20 ms ceiling as AdamW

stop_reason.arithmetic: 1110 - 21.3 (item 1) = 1088.7 ms; items 2/3 ceilings ~6-8 and ~10-20 ms, so the three items together land near 1065-1080 ms, not 850
stop_reason.why: measured launch floor is 28.6 ms of a 1110 ms step (2.6%, GRAPH3); fusing kernels removes count, not device time. The 610 ms gap to 500 ms is device work in the backward of 62 band-block levels plus 1432 bf16 cast kernels
